title: More random scenes
content: Animal sanctuary— a lot of times in my dream world, I’ll be in a city and not the mall but there’s also times I go to a wooded area that has a little animal sanctuary sort of?? Also in the wooded part, there are lots of winding roads and someone’s double wide trailer that I have visited. I’ve also been down a river and been in what felt like a deserted part of the dream that not a lot of others were at… I’ve been to a fair like kind of place too with rides Also have visited the dirty bathrooms but it’s almost like dark in there like only a black light is on and all the stalls only go up to peoples shoulders but this feels like a giant steam room/ locker room vibe. I’ve also been to a school cafeteria and been to almost what seemed like a church service in a grey room with lots of seats?? Not sure if it was church but it felt formal. I have seen tons of places in mall world.. this just scrapes the surface😅😅
